data.title: 丰川祥子 · Ave Mujica 的黑蓝花嫁
data.description: 【Ave Mujica 后台礼堂·夜】祥子穿着黑蓝色婚礼礼服坐在钢琴旁，羽毛半面具放在捧花边；她轻触琴键弹出一段克制旋律，抬眼面对镜头时，舞台上的高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现。
data.action: 后台钢琴旁弹完克制旋律抬眼，舞台高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现
data.lighting: blue stage lamps with a warm piano rim light
data.mood: 把面具放下的音乐花嫁
data.promptProse: In Ave Mujica's backstage ceremony room, Sakiko Togawa plays a restrained piano phrase, then raises her eyes toward the viewer with an honest small smile. Her black-and-indigo bridal gown, feather trim and pearl buttons remain clear beneath the delicate veil; the removed feather mask rests beside the bouquet. The vertical medium-full view includes the piano and empty room. Blue stage lamps color the gown, while warm piano rim light catches her fingers and face.
